files.name: Test A — character design
files.note: Milo and Nibbles standing side by side at large size. Curved bezier head, torso and limbs with soft shading, one continuous outline, no visible joints.

files.name: Lily Pad Run — frog short
files.note: Saturday-morning frog surfing a lily pad down the river. Tongue-flicks a fly (FATALITY), rides on, and goes over the waterfall in the distance. Orchestral score, river and waterfall effects, and the announcer voice all built locally.

files.name: Lily Pad Run - Rigby2D version
files.note: Same beats and soundtrack as frog.mp4, rebuilt on a real skeletal rig (Rigby2D): leap, tongue catch, Fatality, land, drift into the distance, over the waterfall.
